title: More ways to make images, audio, and cat comics
summary:
The project directory grew across creative tools, chat, and games, while text-request queues got a closer look.

The Creative projects directory gained Text2Image_audio, CatGPT Meme Generator, MrEgonAI, and Image Creator. The additions span Chinese-language image and audio generation, personalized cat comics, and image creation with multilingual prompts. Other directory edits added and then removed x-files image generator and GeoNameBase.com, so those listings are not counted as current additions.

A Mita joined the games directory, and two PRs listed the same multi-model chat app, AI drafterplus. GPT_Project moved to Social Bots with corrected Telegram bot details. The project submission template now matches the directory's seven categories.

Text-service queue settings now distinguish token-authenticated requests from referrer-based requests with explicit time windows. Roblox and gacha11211 referrers no longer force the llamascout model. The same PR adjusted feed filtering, image prompt enhancement's referrer, and reporting for full IP queues and ad impressions.
